Subject: RFP bake-off — asking for pilot credits and trial extension

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look. We're running a head-to-head RFP next month where two vendors will be benchmarked across ingestion, latency, and accuracy on our clinical summarization workload. One of the competing vendors has offered a fairly generous pilot package; to be competitive we need a bit more runway.

Can Redwood provide a pilot credit allocation and a trial extension? Rough ask: 100k token credit and a 60–90 day extension to the trial window. We will be running automated and manual evals; results will directly feed the procurement decision.

Attached the RFP summary and expected test plan (EdgeHealth_RFP_Summary.pdf). Procurement is looped on this thread.

Primary asks:
- 100k token credit (apply to account during pilot)
- 60–90 day trial extension
- Confirmation that Redwood will not throttle during the bench run (we'll provide expected QPS shape)

Can you confirm what is feasible and any gating/terms? Appreciate a quick reply — timelines are tight.

Best,
Tim O'Neill
Director of Data Science
EdgeHealth
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@edgehealth.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — asking for pilot credits and trial extension

Hi Tim — great to meet you over email.

Thanks for the RFP summary. We can support competitive pilots and want EdgeHealth to have a fair window to evaluate performance. Tentative offer from Redwood: 50k token credit + 60-day trial extension, with the option to escalate to 100k tokens pending a short approvals checklist (see below).

Conditions for escalation to 100k tokens:
- Signed pilot terms (no resale, evaluation-only)
- Mutually agreed MA Plan with dates and test corpus (attach expected QPS)
- A single point of contact for incident/throughput coordination during the bench run

If you can confirm those items I can submit for an expedited approval. I attached our quick RFP intake template to capture the scope (EdgeHealth_RFP_Summary.pdf you already provided — helpful).

Next step: I'll run this with sales ops and finance for the escalation. Who should I include as the PO/contract contact?

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: EdgeHealth RFP — request for 100k token escalation (need approval)

Soojin / Karthik —

EdgeHealth running a competitive bake-off. They asked for 100k tokens + 60–90 day extension. I propose we approve 100k tokens but with controls so this doesn't set a precedent for open-market credits. Suggested structure:

Proposal (approval ask):
- Credit: 100,000 tokens applied as platform credits to EH account (not reusable beyond the RFP).
- Trial extension: 90 days from activation.
- Allowed usage: evaluation workloads listed in the attached intake doc only; total QPS cap and monthly cap to avoid abuse.
- Expiration: credits expire at trial end; any unused credits are forfeited.
- Accounting: book as partner/marketing pilot (not discount) — we'll use credit-memo.pdf template.

Conditions we should require from customer before issuing credits:
1) Signed pilot terms (we'll generate via DocuSign).
2) MA Plan with clear dates and test corpus.
3) Confirmation they will not share tokens externally.

I've attached a quick allocation sheet (pilot-credits-memo.xlsx) with a suggested token-to-dollar mapping for recognition.

Please advise if ops/finance/legal need anything else. If you give a onetime OK I will send the DocuSign and finalize the terms with Tim.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Subject: Approved: EdgeHealth pilot credits and 90-day extension — next steps + DocuSign

Tim —

Good news: Redwood will provide the 100,000 token pilot credit and extend your trial window to 90 days. Conditions and mechanics below.

What you get:
- 100,000 tokens of platform credit, applied directly to your EdgeHealth account upon execution of the pilot terms.
- 90-day trial extension measured from the activation date in DocuSign.
- Operational support: dedicated throughput contact (Jonas) for bench scheduling and short runbooks for load shaping.

Gating & terms (summary):
- Evaluation-only use; no resale or redistribution.
- Usage caps and test-corpus alignment must match the MA Plan you provided.
- Credits expire at the end of the 90-day window; unused tokens are forfeited.
- Redwood reserves the right to throttle only if platform health is at risk (we will notify you and coordinate).

Attachments included: pilot-credits-memo.xlsx, credit-memo.pdf, EdgeHealth_RFP_Summary.pdf

DocuSign: please sign the pilot terms here to activate credits — https://docusign.com/sign/ABC123
HubSpot: HS-12894 will reflect the allocation and billing classification.

Once signed we'll apply the credit and schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Jonas to confirm test windows and QPS profile. Let me know the best PO/contract contact for procurement routing and when you expect to sign.
